title: Opening the prayer
cue: "O Allah, put distance between me and my sins…"
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
transliteration: Allaahumma baa'id baynee wabayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, allaahumma naqqinee minal-khataayaa kamaa yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allaahummaghsil khataayaaya bil-maa'i wath-thalji wal-barad
translation: O Allah, put distance between me and my sins as You have put distance between the east and the west. O Allah, cleanse me of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow and hail.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 744: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/1223

when: Silently, after the opening [[takbir]] and before the Fatihah
usage.evidence: Abu Hurayrah asked the Prophet ﷺ what he said in his silence between the takbir and the recitation, and he said this (al-Bukhari 744).
